description: Fleet health (GOAL-04) from scripts/fleet_health_report.py. Live row = latest 10-minute check (vpt-fleet-health-live.timer); Last night row = 07:00 check with AI analysis (vpt-fleet-health.timer). History = nightly checks. Each row shows the date/time of its check.

panels.title: 🟢 Live — capture pipeline, checked every 10 minutes

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "OK" FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) fleet_health WHERE fleet_health.run_kind = 'live' AND fleet_health.generated_at = (SELECT max(generated_at) FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) fleet_health WHERE run_kind = 'live') AND verdict = 'OK' AND fleet_health.host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ','))

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.host_name AS "Host", COALESCE(f.device_name, f.device_id) AS "Device", f.device_model AS "Model", f.verdict AS "Verdict", f.reason AS "Reason" FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) f WHERE f.run_kind = 'live' AND f.generated_at = (SELECT max(generated_at) FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) fleet_health WHERE run_kind = 'live') AND f.host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')) ORDER BY f.host_name, f.device_id

panels.title: Last night check at
panels.description: Date/time of the nightly check (vpt-fleet-health.timer, 07:00 Europe/Zurich).

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.host_name AS "Host", COALESCE(f.device_name, f.device_id) AS "Device", f.device_model AS "Model", f.verdict AS "Verdict", f.issue_since AS "Issue since", f.reason AS "Reason", COALESCE(f.ai_analysis, '') AS "AI analysis", CASE WHEN f.last_script_name IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN f.last_script_success THEN '✅ ' ELSE '❌ ' END) || f.last_script_name ELSE '—' END AS "Last script", CASE WHEN f.report_url IS NOT NULL THEN 'open' ELSE '' END AS "Report" FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) f WHERE f.run_kind = 'nightly' AND f.generated_at = (SELECT max(generated_at) FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) fleet_health WHERE run_kind = 'nightly') AND f.host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')) ORDER BY f.host_name, f.device_id

SELECT generated_at AS time, verdict AS metric, count(*)::float AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) fleet_health WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at) AND run_kind = 'nightly' AND host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.generated_at AS "Time", f.host_name AS "Host", COALESCE(f.device_name, f.device_id) AS "Device", f.verdict AS "Verdict", f.issue_since AS "Issue since", f.reason AS "Reason", COALESCE(f.ai_analysis, '') AS "AI analysis" FROM (SELECT * FROM fleet_health /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.generated_at) AND f.run_kind = 'nightly' AND f.verdict IN ('DEGRADED', 'DOWN', 'UNKNOWN') AND f.host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')) ORDER BY f.generated_at DESC, f.host_name, f.device_id LIMIT 200
